summaryZh: 本文报道了奥地利中耕专家Einböck推出的新型Invera株间精准中耕机在荷兰甜菜田的首次实地测试。尽管天气潮湿、条件恶劣，该机借助捷克Ullmanna公司的植物识别技术，以约2 km/h的速度实现了精准除草。文章介绍了机器与Claas Culticam相机的组合，以及经销商Reesink Agri在技术调试中的角色，展示了智能农机在作物保护领域的实际应用进展。
featuredReason: 该新闻展示了AI视觉识别与精准农机在作物保护中的深度融合，对智慧畜牧行业人士理解跨领域自动化技术趋势具有启发意义。

Tested: first Einböck intra-row precision hoe

 23-06 | Crop solutions | Article

Under challenging, wet conditions, the 4-row Einböck Invera made its first passes in a sugar beet field in Eexterveen (Drenthe) on 9 June. Partly because of the wet conditions, the cameras initially had some difficulty controlling the depth adjustment per element properly. While Christiaan Borkus of importer Reesink Agri made the final adjustments on the tablet, the blades nevertheless hoed neatly around the beet plants at about 2 km/h. Photos: Hans Banus

In a market that is currently, to put it mildly, on its knees, Austrian hoeing specialist Einböck is presenting its new Invera intra-row precision hoe. Perhaps its strongest asset is plant recognition from the Czech company Ullmanna. This makes the Invera even more distinctive. With Einböck, Dutch importer Reesink Agri has always had a strong card to play when it comes to hoeing technology. The machines are known for being solid and robust.
